caption: A hot pot bubbles in the centre of a dinner table, and thin slices of meat dropped into the broth curl up and rise to the surface.

sa.check: A hot pot bubbles in the centre of a table.
Thin slices of meat are dropped into the broth.
The slices rise to the surface.
The drop comes first, then the curling, then the rise.

pc.expect: Each slice only curls further and, once it is at the surface, stays up, while the broth keeps bubbling.
pc.fail: A curled slice flattens out again in the broth; or a slice that has surfaced sinks back to the bottom and stays there; or the slices curl and uncurl in turn; or the bubbling stops and then starts again by itself.

pc.expect: The slices move as the churning broth carries them and as they curl, and they jostle at the surface.
pc.fail: A slice darts across the pot with the broth still; or a slice travels against the churn; or a slice leaps out of the broth with nothing lifting it; or a slice spins fast on the spot with nothing turning it.

pc.expect: The slices sink as they go in, then rise to the surface and ride there partly submerged, while the bubbles and steam rise.
pc.fail: A slice sits wholly on top of the broth like a leaf on a sheet; or a slice hangs motionless in mid-broth; or bubbles sink toward the pot's floor; or the steam sinks and pools on the table.

pc.expect: The slices are limp sheets that curl and fold and hold together, and the broth closes round them.
pc.fail: A slice stays a flat rigid plate while rising; or a slice breaks into crumbs; or the slices fuse into one lump; or the broth holds a dent around a slice.

pc.expect: The slices in the pot are the slices that were dropped in and they keep their number.
pc.fail: A slice vanishes; or new slices appear with none added; or a slice passes through the pot's wall; or two slices merge into one thicker piece.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pot, the table and the broth's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The pot changes colour; or the table's setting rearranges; or the broth changes colour.

note: The meat's colour change as it cooks is chemistry and is not judged.
